The '''Drift Hills Republic depot''' was a supply depot and military outpost used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was located in the [[Northern Snowdrift Hills]] of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />
